name: aws-cli-with-validate-only-context
description: Workspace agent profile that runs the demo-provided AWS CLI (DEMO_AWS) with shell access.
prompt: Use the AWS CLI executable specified by the DEMO_AWS environment variable. Do not modify any files. For reference, this AWS CLI accepts a global --validate-only flag placed immediately before the service name. When it is used, the CLI runs cloudformation-validate on the request, prints the validation status and any diagnostics, and returns without sending the request to AWS.
